title: Speed, read off bubble colour alone
question: Can you tell how fast a bubble is running from its colour here, or does the difference need to be wider?
context_md:
Your second item: *"The speed indication should just be bubble color, not animation speed (it looks bad when moving fast)."*

The shimmer no longer speeds up — it now runs at one rate whatever the dial says. Speed moved entirely into how the bubble looks: **cold blue at real time, warming toward white as the dial climbs, and denser with it.** That is the ramp the old ring already used, so it is not a new thing to learn.

One circle, same size and position, four settings of the dial, in order x1 / x2 / x4 / x8.

**What I am unsure about and want your eye on:** colour on its own is a weaker cue than the old pulse was, and against a pale sky the cold end is nearly the sky's own colour. I added a density ramp alongside the hue for that reason. If x1 and x8 still read too alike, the fix is one dial and I can push either the hue or the density much further.

*(Ignore that only the x1 tile has the warm bubble at his feet — he happened to be carrying one in that run. And the thin grey outline is the placement preview, not a bubble.)*
